mapper.sql: ID, TITLE, TARGET_AMOUNT, START_DATE, END_DATE, INVITE_CODE, MISSION_MODE, CREATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT c.ID AS CHALLENGE_ID, c.TITLE AS TITLE, c.TARGET_AMOUNT AS GOAL_AMOUNT, c.START_DATE AS START_DATE, c.END_DATE AS END_DATE, NVL(agg.TOTAL_BALANCE, 0) AS CURRENT_BALANCE, NVL(agg.MEMBER_COUNT, 0) AS MEMBER_COUNT, me.THEME_COLOR AS THEME_COLOR FROM CHALLENGE c JOIN MEMBER me ON me.CHALLENGE_ID = c.ID AND me.USER_ID = #{userId} AND me.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.CHALLENGE_ID AS CHALLENGE_ID, SUM(NVL(a.BALANCE, 0)) AS TOTAL_BALANCE, COUNT(*) AS MEMBER_COUNT FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT a ON a.MEMBER_ID = m.ID WHERE m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY m.CHALLENGE_ID) agg ON agg.CHALLENGE_ID = c.ID ORDER BY c.CREATED_AT DESC, c.ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHALLENGE (TITLE, TARGET_AMOUNT, START_DATE, END_DATE, INVITE_CODE, MISSION_MODE) VALUES (#{title}, #{targetAmount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{inviteCode}, #{missionMode})
